name: cc_program
description: Roadmap Phase 6 (G4) program build as TEAMS OF TEAMS (H3) with an ARCHITECT. The Architect (the planner session) decomposes the program into subsystems and drafts the definition of done; scouts find and red-prove external checks (a real client suite, a scenario, a budget, a docs check) that the builders did not write; The scouts run beside the first rank's build (both read the plan's criteria, which fix the interface); once the contract is on the branch every later dispatch reads it from the checkout into its implementers' and reviewers' prompts, and the final contract run is the sign-off. Subsystems are built rank by rank, each by its own child team_build on the shared program branch; after every rank and at the final head the Architect runs the whole contract, scores the head (the weighted share of checks passing) and files items for the gaps. Under the threshold the convergence ladder takes rework, a change of approach, a second opinion and only then a named need: the only terminal verdict is PROGRAM_DELIVERED; PROGRAM_NEEDS ends the run with what it needs and a continuation resumes at the recorded rung. No WAIT, no human gate, no timeouts, one version.

plan.name: plan_loop
plan.loopCondition: (function(){ var cur = $.plan_loop[String($.plan_loop['iteration'])] || {}; var r = (cur['program_parse'] || {})['route']; return $.plan_loop['iteration'] <= $.max_replan && r === 'replan'; })();

agents.description: how many agents this team's swarm runs in parallel: the number of parallel items you cut for it, sized by the subsystem's complexity

threshold.description: the weighted share of checks that must pass for the program to be delivered; 1.0 unless a budget or docs check is advisory

claim.description: the claim of the request this check proves, in the request's own words

hint.description: what a scout should look for: a client, a conformance suite, a scenario, a budget, a docs check

command.description: the one argv line that runs the check from the repository root (no shell operators), e.g. `node .cc/checks/scenario.mjs`; with 'script', required

setup.description: argv lines that install what the command needs under .cc-cache/ (idempotent; run before every check run)

interface.description: the exact user-facing interface the check drives, in one paragraph: invocation, ports, paths, labels, expected output

script.description: the check's script, WRITTEN NOW by the Architect: a path under .cc/checks/ (.mjs, .cjs, .sh or .py, never .js) and its full content. A check with a script needs no scout: it is committed before the first team forks

inputParameters.report: The decomposition gate rejected the program plan (after maxReplan rounds); no team was spawned.

workflowOutput.report: The decomposition gate rejected the program plan (after maxReplan rounds); no team was spawned.

inputParameters.report: The subsystem dependencies do not form a DAG; no team was spawned.

workflowOutput.report: The subsystem dependencies do not form a DAG; no team was spawned.

forkTasks.name: rank_loop
forkTasks.loopCondition: (function(){ var cur = $.rank_loop[String($.rank_loop['iteration'])] || {}; var go = (cur['apply_rank'] || {})['continue']; return $.rank_loop['iteration'] < $.max_iterations && go === true; })();

tasks.name: convergence_loop
tasks.loopCondition: (function(){ var cur = $.convergence_loop[String($.convergence_loop['iteration'])] || {}; var go = (cur['architect_fold'] || {})['continue']; return $.convergence_loop['iteration'] < $.max_iterations && go === true; })();

inputParameters.prompt: Approve or reject the proposed amendments of the definition of done: ${architect_fold.output.amendText}

weights.description: on reject: the weight each named check should have (0 drops it)
